{{Quote|My name is Rycus Kilran. I'm commander of the Fifth Fleet, second to the Minister of War, and—my personal favorite—the so-called "Butcher of Coruscant."|Grand Moff Kilran introduces himself to prospective allies onboard the ''[[Black Talon]]''|audio=Kilran-MyNameIs-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR:TBT">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Black Talon}}</ref>}}
'''Rycus Kilran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. He was best known for his role during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], which earned him the nickname of the "'''Butcher of Coruscant'''," and as the pacifier of the [[Togruta Uprising]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm told you disobeyed a direct order from Grand Moff Kilran.|Unidentified Imperial spacer to Captain [[Revinal Orzik]] of the ''Black Talon''|<ref name="TOR:TBT" />}}
Born on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to a wealthy family with a proud military tradition, Kilran grew into a creative strategist and military leader. He proved himself, to no one's surprise, a capable right-hand man to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] early assaults on the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]]. When his [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Brema sector)|Sith superior]] died during the [[Battle of Ord Ibanna]], who Rycus was serving as tactical [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]&mdash;he assumed command of the ragged [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]] and led them to a swift and decisive victory.<ref name="Biographies" />

[[File:Imperial_Fifth_Fleet.png|left|thumb|250px|Rycus Kilran and soldiers of the Imperial Fifth Fleet]]
In the years that followed, Kilran's authority grew with his list of triumphs, and both the Sith and the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]] learned respect for his unorthodox strategies. His brutally effective strikes during the final days of the war, as well as his tactics during the [[Sacking of Coruscant|Sacking]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], earned the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] the nickname "the Butcher of Coruscant" among [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] civilians, a name he adopted with characteristic irony. His heroic stand against a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] boarding party earned him his scars. After the war ended, he was granted the honorary title [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] in recognition of his contributions.<ref name="Biographies" />

[[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|After]] the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], Kilran had become the commander of the [[Imperial Fifth Fleet]].<ref name="TOR:TBT" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Grand Moff ordered [[Revinal Orzik]], captain of the Imperial transport ''[[Black Talon]]'', to [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|intercept]] a Republic warship, the ''[[Brentaal Star]]'', and eliminate the wanted passenger, a [[The General|renegade Imperial general]]. When Captain Orzik refused to carry on what he saw as a suicide mission, Kilran sent a small team of operatives to take care of the situation.<ref name="TOR:TBT" /> Around the same time, Kilran [[Assault on the Esseles|attacked]] of the Republic vessel [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] with the objective of arresting [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Vyn Asara]] on charges of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]] and sedition against the Empire. However, the Grand Moff had to deal with a Republic boarding party sent against his flagship, the ''[[Emperor's Glory]]''.<ref name="TOR:TE" />

===Defeat at the Maelstrom===
{{Quote|I don't deserve this...there was so much left to conquer...|Kilran is defeated by the Republic strike team|<ref name="TOR:MP" />}}
[[File:Rycus_Kilran.png|right|thumb|250px|Kilran engages the intruders at Maelstrom in his last stand]]
Towards the end of the Cold War, Kilran was charged with maintaining the prison within [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]] where the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] had held a powerful prisoner - the Jedi Master [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] - for three hundred years. He was confronted by the same Republic strike team from the ''Esseles'', now dispatched by Master [[Oteg]].<ref name="TOR:MP" /> The team had [[Battle of Taral V|obtained]] a [[Gree computer]] to navigate the Maelstrom from the [[Taral V Imperial fortress|Imperial base]] on [[Taral V]], despite Kilran's efforts to bombard the planet before they could successfully escape.<ref name="TOR:T5">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Taral V}}</ref>

Impressed and infuriated by the persistence of the Republic team, Kilran personally boarded the prison and informed [[Darth Malgus]] - who was watching from a nearby holoterminal - that he would put the intruders out of their misery. Malgus ordered him to focus solely on preserving the prisoner, but Kilran elected to attack anyway, believing he could deal with the problem. In the end, however, he proved unable to withstand the [[Battle of the Maelstrom|assault]] as the Republic forces struck him down in the prison's core, putting an end to the Butcher of Coruscant.<ref name="TOR:MP" />

Upon his death, Kilran was succeeded by Grand Moff [[Ilyan Regus]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Grand Moff Regus}}</ref> A memorial statue was commissioned in Kilran's honor, and was set to be constructed once the [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] decided a suitable location for it on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Personality and traits==
Apart from being the most cunning Imperial strategist the Empire had to offer, he has been described as both charismatic and an intellectual genius. He is also very patriotic towards the Empire and would no doubt fight to the bitter end for it. He also had a strong sense of pride; when he was faced with the team of individuals who had repeatedly humiliated him he was willing to disobey Darth Malgus and try to kill them rather than securing Revan like he was ordered to. He was also a great lover of fine [[Wine/Legends|wines]].<ref name="Biographies" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Grand_Moff_Kilran-TOR.png|thumb|180px|Grand Moff Kilran]]
Kilran was first introduced through a development diary released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="VD3">{{TORweb|url=news/article/20090717_002|text=The Voice of the Old Republic|nolive=1}}</ref>

There are several phrases written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on his page at the official site. When transliterated, they read "defense of the secret prison," "Chasing the General," and "personal combat expert."<ref name="Biographies" />
